notchAgents.empty: No usage from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or GitHub Copilot yet. It appears here as soon as any of them works on this PC.
notchAgents.settingsDescription: Reads the usage Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and GitHub Copilot record on this PC and the plan limits the Claude app saves. Prompts, replies and files are never kept, and your usage never leaves your PC.
notchAgents.claudeLimitsNoApp: Plan limits come from the Claude app, which is not on this PC. Until then, the 5-hour session is estimated from Claude Code activity.
notchAgents.claudeLimitsMenuBar: Claude checks your limits only while it runs in the system tray. Keep the Claude app running, and your limits appear here within minutes.
notchAgents.claudeLimitsPrivacy: Only the percentages the Claude app saves on this PC are read. No sign-in is used and nothing is sent.
notchAgents.noCards: Choose what this tab shows in the AI Agents settings.
win.agentUsage.locationCaption: Leave empty to use the standard location. Environment variables such as CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, CODEX_HOME, XDG_DATA_HOME and COPILOT_HOME are honored.
win.agentUsage.notificationsOff: Windows notifications are off for this app, so alerts won't appear. Turn them on in Windows Settings › System › Notifications.
win.agentUsage.copilotNote: Only the GitHub Copilot CLI keeps a usage log; Copilot in VS Code, Visual Studio and JetBrains is not counted, and premium requests are not shown.
win.agentUsage.wslNote: Agents running inside WSL keep their logs in the Linux file system and are not read.
win.agentUsage.opencodeUnavailable: OpenCode's database needs SQLite, which was not found.
